title: a bare call is a BaseShim hook, so the librarian wakes without overriding the root-verb resolver
intention: A device's answer to a bare call is a hook on BaseShim (_bare), so the librarian wakes on a bare `cairn librarian` without overriding _resolve, which every roster device must inherit.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: test_root_verb_vocabulary.py's test_every_roster_device_inherits_the_root_verbs reds over cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py:62, where LibrarianShim._resolve (commit 1cccda9b5, ticket d832a24e5144, PROVED) overrides BaseShim._resolve to wake the librarian on a bare call (Q#30). The tools/base commit-hook reseal sealed that red on the Dell, with its two dependents, and it blocks d692ef650534's PROVED. The override is legitimate in what it does and only wrong in where: it passes every other argv to super.
traces_to: Law 4 (the root vocabulary is physics in test_root_verb_vocabulary; an override is a device opting out of it) and RULE 1 (a device extends its shim through a declared hook, never by replacing the inherited resolver).
how: (a) cairn/tools/base/shim.py: BaseShim._resolve's `if not argv:` returns self._bare(); `_bare(self) -> dict` returns today's answer exactly: {exit 0, text 'device: <dev>\nclass:  cairn/devices/<dev>/', data None, cached None}. (b) cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py: LibrarianShim._resolve becomes _bare(self): self._ensure_device(), then the chat answer as today; the super() fallthrough goes. (c) Red-first proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_bare_call_is_a_shim_hook.py.

clauses.claim: test_root_verb_vocabulary.py::test_every_roster_device_inherits_the_root_verbs passes: no roster shim overrides resolve or _resolve
a bare `cairn librarian` still wakes the librarian and opens its chat with no URL printed: cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_a_bare_librarian_opens_its_chat.py stays green
a BaseShim subclass that overrides only _bare answers a bare call with _bare's answer, and BaseShim's default bare answer is today's device/class text

decisions.text: D1: BaseShim gains _bare; _resolve's bare branch returns it.
D2: LibrarianShim overrides _bare and drops its _resolve override.
D3: the proof, one tooth per clause; clauses 1 and 2 run the two standing proofs as subprocesses (pytest -k for clause 1), clause 3 in-process with a throwaway subclass.

measured.how: bin/cairn test cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_root_verb_vocabulary.py on akienasus at main
